For F.Y. 2020-21 to 2023-24,Audit has been conducted by CGST Audit Commissionerate, Ahmedabad. Following poits remains unsettled during Audit and SCN has been issued on 01/04/2026 with following ponits. 1) Observation by Department:-Exclusion of Interest Income while calculating Exempt Turnover. Amount of Discipancy:- Rs.43,24,665/-. Stand of The Sandesh Limited:-We have argument that The allegation is misconceived as explaination-1 to rule 43 for the purpose of Rule 42 (determining common credit available & exempt income) sepcifically excludes interest . 2) Observation by Department:- ITC taken on Calendar printing considered as taken for Non Business Purpose. Amount of Discripancy:- Rs. 10,75,795/-.Stand of The Sandesh Limited:-The allegation is not sustainable as printing and distribution of calender in lieu of regular supplement on the occation of new year for the purpose of a bussiness and is generally followed by most of publication. 3) Observation by Department:- ITC taken on decorative items not allowed due to being considered under blocked credit. Amount of Discripancy:- Rs. 76,826/-.Stand of The Sandesh Limited:-ITC on decorative items is not covered under any of clause of section 17(5) of CGST Act.
